rationale: Roberts is likely to keep the opinion narrow and institutional, adopting the entrenched dies-non/time-computation baseline (Rule 6(a)-style) to treat a weekend/holiday 60th day as rolling to the next business day without framing it as an equitable extension barred by Dada. Alito is the most likely separate writer, dissenting on the theory that § 1229c’s “not more than 60 days” is a hard calendar cap on authorized presence and that rollover improperly enlarges a statutory maximum.
